comment: session.resume against a session that is live mid-turn (_live_session_payload, server.py:7588-7602). `inflight` is the ONLY carrier of a terminal frame lost while disconnected — there is no server-side event replay (reference-clients.md 7.1). The projected user row is normally ALSO present in `messages`, so it must be de-duplicated against the contiguous run of trailing user rows. `corrections` are mid-turn redirects, oldest first.
